assumptions: Masses are design scenarios, not measured robot masses or season limits
Closing speed is relative, not each robot speed
Compression is combined relative crush distance, not bumper thickness
Perfectly inelastic normal collision; no external field/traction impulse
Average force from energy/distance does not establish peak force or strength
Offset moment scale is not a solved off-axis collision
No bumper stiffness, attachment stress, fatigue, fastener shear, retention or injury claim
